title_en: He Stands at the Gate, Dos
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Дос' is a refrain I could not identify; I left it as 'dos'. Lines 'Горно маалки' and the last stanza are my reading.
